name: multi_layer_hex
summary: Pure-math sidecar field generator. Packs 8 modal embedding slots into one deterministic 512-char hex envelope (256 bytes = 8 slots * 32 bytes). Each slot holds the int8-quantized leading 32 dims of its source vector OR 32 zero bytes when absent. Length-stable: callers slice by slot index without parsing. NOT a connector — pure stdlib transform built on energy_inversion.to_hex_int8 (with stdlib fallback). Output is a SIDECAR field on InferenceRecord and intentionally NOT part of canonical_json() in schema v1 — folding it into the chain hash is a v2-schema task that requires re-genesis.
engine_pattern: stateless transform. Per-slot: extract source vector → take first 32 dims → pad zeros → int8 quantize (scale=127, round-half-to-nearest, clamp [-127,127]) → byte-cast → hex. Slot 7 is byte-wise XOR of slots 0 ⊕ 1 (sentence ⊕ svg) as a differential-amplifier sanity check.

slot_layout.1_svg: first 32 dims of svg_vector_embed.embed_svg_file(record['source_file'])[0].embedding when path ends in .svg
slot_layout.2_wave: first 32 dims of record['wave_emb'] (the 64-d DCT-II spectrum from tri_modal_embedder)
slot_layout.5_dialectic_position: EMPTY in v1 — reserved for dialectic_walker integration (32 zero bytes)
slot_layout.6_visual_bitmap_dct: EMPTY in v1 — reserved for visual DCT slot (32 zero bytes)
slot_layout.7_antipodal_xor: byte-wise XOR of slot 0 ⊕ slot 1 (sentence ⊕ svg differential-amplifier)

envelope_spec.slot_index_to_hex_offset: slot N starts at index N*64

substrate: stateless (caller persists hex string on record.multi_layer_hex)

sidecar_discipline.rule: pack_layers() output MUST NOT be added to InferenceRecord.canonical_json() in schema_version='v1'
sidecar_discipline.why: the existing crystal chain must keep verifying — folding multi_layer_hex into the hash would break every prior record
sidecar_discipline.caller_pattern: crystal_id = logger.log(...); record = logger.get_record(crystal_id); record['multi_layer_hex'] = pack_layers(record)
sidecar_discipline.future_v2: schema_version='v2' may include multi_layer_hex in the canonical hash; that migration requires re-genesis and is explicitly not implemented here

inbound_callers: moe_router (slot-wise distance lookup against a single hex envelope per record)
any inference_logger caller that wants the sidecar field attached AFTER log() returns
outbound_calls: stdlib math + struct fallback when any of the above are unavailable

guarantees: Deterministic — same record dict → same 512-char hex, byte-exact
Length-stable — output is always exactly 512 lowercase hex chars
Slot-addressable — slot N starts at hex index N*64 with no delimiters
Empty-slot safe — missing modalities become 32 zero bytes (never variable-length)
Stdlib-only fallback — if energy_inversion/sentence_chain/svg_vector_embed aren't importable, packer still works via the internal int8 codec
Sidecar-pure — does NOT touch inference_logger.canonical_json or chain hashing
usage_example:
from multi_layer_hex import pack_layers, slot_distance, has_slot, SLOT_NAMES
h = pack_layers({'original_prompt': 'hello', 'wave_emb': [0.1]*64, 'time_vec': {'forward': [0.2]*32, 'inverted': [-0.2]*32}})
assert len(h) == 512
assert has_slot(h, 'sentence')
d = slot_distance(h_a, h_b, 'wave')  # cosine-style distance over slot 2 only
